3d.rule: Hungarian on 3D centre distance, label-compatible pairs only, gate max(min_gate, gate_diagonal_fraction * diagonal)

2d.rule: Hungarian maximising summed 2D IoU (detection box vs visible ground-truth box) over pairs with IoU >= min_iou; class-agnostic; no 3D gate

definitions.recall: paired present objects / present objects (views run with the depth source)
definitions.confusion_rate: pairs whose detection phrase does not map to the object's label / pairs
definitions.share_beyond_3d_gate: pairs whose 3D centre distance exceeds max(0.5 m, 0.5 * box diagonal)
definitions.confused_share_beyond_3d_gate: confused pairs beyond that gate; with reference depth (laser, rendered) a confused pair within it is the right object misnamed, one beyond it a candidate wrong-object pairing
definitions.range: distance from the camera centre to the ground-truth box centre (m)
definitions.coverage: questions with an automatic answer / questions about views run with the depth source
definitions.abs_error: |auto - oracle|: metres for numeric question types, objects for counts; none for choices
definitions.wrong_rate: share of answered items that is_correct rejects
definitions.subsets: all: answered; both: answered under both associations; new: only under 2D; lost: only under 3D; confused / label_correct: 2D items with some / no referent paired with a detection of another class
definitions.n_same_answer: items of the 'both' subset whose automatic answer is identical under the two associations
